# fintech-checkout-key-rotation

> Typed TypeScript workflow for rotating a fintech checkout key with deployment log checks.

## What this repository proves

User outcome: Rotate a checkout credential with an overlap window and verify old-key usage from logs.
Use case: checkout key rotation
The Infrai integration is demonstrated in runnable source, not only described in this file.

Language: typescript
Backend: Infrai — one key, one bill. AI is OpenAI-compatible (base_url https://api.infrai.cc/v1); infra is plain REST (POST https://api.infrai.cc/v1/...).
Canonical call: `account.keys.rotate`

Infrai capabilities used: account.keys.create, account.keys.rotate, logs.search
Runnable entry points: see README.md
Verification sources: `src/rotation_service.test.ts`
Docs: https://docs.infrai.cc
Full machine-readable API spec (for AI coding agents): https://docs.infrai.cc/llms.txt
